title: Internal official-source residential verification matrix
objective: Independently check official reference values and implemented residential-rule outputs; test real parcels across boroughs and publish specific coverage gaps without requiring repeated architect input.
business_reason: Routine correctness and regression testing belongs to the development team.
outputs: Independent official-source expected-value matrix for residential district families and conditions.
Real-parcel sample across all five boroughs, including subtype and special/mixed/alias contexts, with per-layer outcomes.
Reusable bounded read-only audit/test harness and consolidated remaining-gap report.

acceptance_scenarios.preconditions: Official current section tables and source meanings retrieved independently
acceptance_scenarios.input: Every supported R1-R12 FAR row plus wide-street and qualifying alternatives
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Exact source-derived values and applicability agree or a specific mismatch is reported; no expected result is copied from implementation
acceptance_scenarios.invariants: Draft verification is not legal publication

acceptance_scenarios.preconditions: Bounded official parcel query and live app read access
acceptance_scenarios.input: Real parcels covering five boroughs and available residential families; aliases, mixed/special/split contexts
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Report identity, source reference, display and calculated-result coverage separately; unavailable families/outputs remain explicit gaps
acceptance_scenarios.invariants: No universal-correctness claim; no repeated architect input
acceptance_scenarios.execution: Bounded read-only live capture and independent review

acceptance_scenarios.input: Changed expected value, unsupported context, malformed/zero/missing input, source mismatch
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Harness detects incorrect values and distinguishes missing coverage from passing numerical calculation
acceptance_scenarios.invariants: No backend/rule bypass, no secret exposure

modularity_boundary.owner: One bounded audit helper; independent expected fixtures

progress_log.message: Independent-source validation scenarios recorded; source capture and harness work begins in isolated validation worktree.

Independent source review confirms current numeric values. Rework reusable audit coverage for input/output units, citation references, official URLs and condition metadata; negative cases must detect all drift categories.
